parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the door of the safe, made of thick steel for security purposes.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main barrier to protect the contents inside the safe, locking securely when closed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is a handle or switch mechanism on the door, made of steel.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to operate the locking mechanism of the safe, allowing the user to lock or unlock the door.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or turns to engage or disengage the locking bolts.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: Another switch or handle component, also made of steel.
parts.Functional_description: It assists in controlling the locking mechanism, possibly part of a multi-handle system.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or pivots to control the internal locking rods.

parts.name: Outlier
parts.Basic_description: This is a small external structural or decorative component made of steel.
parts.Functional_description: It may serve as a hinge cover or reinforcement element.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Outlier
parts.Basic_description: Another minor external or internal structural part made of steel.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional support or alignment for the door or frame.
parts.Movement_description: It is stationary and does not move during use.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the safe, made of thick steel panels.
parts.Functional_description: It forms the main enclosure that holds and protects the contents inside the safe.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed structure and does not move during operation.
